statement: ∀ (J : Submodule (LR.R p) (LR.C p)) (z : ℚ ⊗[LR.R p] J), ∃ D : ℕ, D ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ c : J, (D : ℚ) • z = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] c
proof:
intro J z
have ht (n : ℤ) (c : J) :
    (n : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] c) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] ((n : LR.R p) • c) := by
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  congr 1
induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
| zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, 0, by simp⟩
| tmul q c =>
  refine ⟨q.den, q.den_nz, (q.num : LR.R p) • c, ?_⟩
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  change ((q.den : ℚ) * q) ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] c = _
  rw [Rat.den_mul_eq_num, ← ht, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  simp
| add z w hz hw =>
  obtain ⟨D, hD, c, hc⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨E, hE, d, hd⟩ := hw
  refine ⟨D*E, Nat.mul_ne_zero hD hE,
    (E : LR.R p) • c + (D : LR.R p) • d, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, smul_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  rw [mul_comm (D : ℚ) (E : ℚ), mul_smul, hc, ← ht (E : ℤ) c]
  rw [mul_comm (E : ℚ) (D : ℚ), mul_smul, hd, ← ht (D : ℤ) d]
  simp only [Int.cast_natCast]
